title: Chapter 694
paragraphs: Chapter 694
Episode 177. Yona, Yona, Yona......(3)
'Joshua? I didn't expect that idiot to appear here.'
Jin narrowed his eyes.
As the void of chaos unfolded and he heard Joshua's voice, Jin felt more annoyance than a sense of crisis.
The feeling of a cockroach suddenly popping up underfoot – not threatening at all, but so repulsive it makes your teeth chatter.
"It's been a while, indeed, but not particularly pleasant. Why are you here when you should be in a dungeon?"
[You ask the obvious. Isn't it because I received my mother's forgiveness? I doubt you didn't know I got out.]
At that, Jin chuckled.

"Forgiveness... Rosa is not that generous. You still don't know Rosa. From her, you should seek recognition, not forgiveness. Tell me, Joshua. How was life in prison? If Rosa pulled you out of jail, there must have been some growth."
Swish!
Somewhere, Yona's sword appeared and vanished, slicing Owl's sleeve. Yona continued to roam near the three like a ghost, brandishing her sword.
[Yes, there was meaning. Thanks to you, I really learned a lot.]
"Really? To me, it just seems like a fool became even more of a fool."
[You still speak harshly. Little brother.]
"I never had a brother like you."
[You can't deny that we share the same blood. Born from the same womb, but standing in different places.]
Hedo and Owl felt Jin losing his calm as soon as Joshua appeared.
But instead of making them anxious, it rather relieved them.
A man of that caliber wouldn't mess things up emotionally, so the newly appeared second flagbearer seemed insignificant to Jin.
"Phew... Joshua, I never imagined you'd show up like this again."
[Then what did you imagine?]
"If you're asking if I wished you would rot and die in the dungeon, of course, I did. I thought it would be most appropriate for you to end your pitiful life there..."
[That wish didn't come true.]
"Don't interrupt me, Joshua. This is the last moment I treat you as a human and converse with you. So listen carefully, you trash."
Jin, glaring as if he would rip apart a single point within the curtain.

"In a way, I hoped you would attain true enlightenment there and challenge me again. I hoped you'd escape from Rosa's clutches, finally become a human, and turn into a more valuable enemy. That's what I wished for, and so did big brother Diphus. Why? Why do you think we felt that way?"
[If that was really your wish, it's already fulfilled. I'm right here in front of you.]
"You're in front of me?"
Jin laughed as if it was absurd and looked around.

"Where on earth are you hiding, taking advantage of Yona like a fungus, only emitting your voice? Can that be truly considered standing in front of me? I'm not sure what you're so proud about learning in prison, but you're the same now as you were then. The same Joshua!"
Clang!
Hedo deflected Yona's blade that fell towards Jin. Jin didn't even divert his gaze.

"The reason we hoped you, a person we wouldn't feel satisfied killing and leaving in the gutters, would come back stronger was because it was unsatisfactory. How could our mortal enemy who plotted against us for such a long time end so pitifully? And not by my hand, but due to a single word from Rosa. What was all the fighting with you for?"
[We'll see if I'm the same as I was then, starting from now. You seem more impatient than I remember.]

"I'll correct my previous statement. You're not the same person you were then. In fact, you've become even less valuable. Your bragging as if I've fallen into your trap is evidence. And your acting as if the power you received from Rosa and the prophet is fully yours! How do you think you can do anything to me with such a pathetic trap?"
Jin wound a blue flame around Bradamante.

"You stupid... If you knew you were going to lose but still came alone and asked to settle things, I would have respected that. Even if your physical body was rotting in a dungeon and unable to wield a sword, even if you couldn't even muster the strength of a 1-star, I would have treated you as a worthy adversary."
But you ended up not understanding anything at all.
As Jin continued in a calmer voice, Joshua remained silent for a while. He was recalling a story he'd heard from Rosa in the past, without realizing it.

-You're not dead yet. And I, I'm looking forward to not just the fulfillment of the prophecy, but also the struggle to break it. Your youngest brother, Jin. It doesn't seem like his struggle won't be able to break the prophecy, no matter how absolute it is.

-If there ever comes a day when your prophecy leads you to the real world of struggle from this dungeon, if you can endure that world. I'll let you return to the surface. Of course... as always, your prophecy will disappoint me again. Just like you always have.
Even then, Jin never forgot the struggle, and Joshua was still in the same place.
Joshua still hadn't realized that fact.
That's why Jin found it hard to gauge why Rosa started using Joshua again.
Why would such a monstrosity, not even needing a puppet like Padler, entrust a job to such a worthless thing?
'There must be a reason, but I have no idea. It can't be a simple whim.'
During the silence, Yona's sword occasionally whizzed aimlessly between the group.

"In the end, because you couldn't stand alone even in this situation... remember that you weren't acknowledged by father, Rosa, or even me, Joshua. This is the end of my last patience with treating you as a human."
Jin pointed his sword, a new magic skill he had accomplished alone when fighting Bale, at a point in the veil of chaos.
Just like ice melting in fire, the veil pointed by the tip of the sword peeled off layer by layer, revealing the fake Yonas hidden behind.
There were seven fakes and one real, a total of eight Yonas were targeting the group in the void.
"[...You've learned a strange sword skill.]"
"If I were you, I'd be too embarrassed to open my mouth. No matter how broken you are, weren't you also a warrior? Jin is showing you a realm you can never reach. So, be grateful."
"[Shut up, Tower Keeper.]"
The Yonas hid their bodies again as soon as they were exposed, and new dimensional gates were opening from where they disappeared.
From that gate, chaos-enhanced monsters poured out. Hedo recognized them as Nethan monsters, originally supposed to be in the Black Sea.
Around this time, Joshua began to have a hunch that his plan was going to fail.
This is because the group wasn't disturbed at all even while watching the Yonas and the Nethan monsters pouring out in droves.
The three of them seemed indifferent to this situation.
Especially Jin, who had previously faced strong adversaries like Paddle and Lionel, as well as divine beings like Bale, and even experienced the power of Rosa, a monstrous deity.
This kind of puppy-like plot wasn't even surprising.
"So, this is all you've prepared? Sister and fakes, and a bunch of Nethan monsters?"
With a swoosh, Jin rushed in and beheaded a fake with one stroke. The fake, approaching Jin, couldn't even swing his sword properly because of the energy spread by the flames of Bradamante.
At that point, Joshua looked back and forth between Jin and the dead Yona in surprise.
According to Joshua's thought, Jin should never kill the Yonas.
"[Have you also chosen to walk a path beyond defeat? Killing Yona without any hesitation.]"
"You talk like a magician, just like Rosa. You're neither a magician nor a defeated, but merely a rogue. Would I kill sister Yona? I killed her because she was a fake."
Jin distinguishing between the real and the fake in an instant wasn't included in his calculation.
In fact, Joshua didn't come here today with the intention to eliminate Jin.
He wanted to see Jin continually in danger because he couldn't kill the Yonas, and eventually kill them all in order to survive, then fall into hatred and despair.
He intended to harvest that despair and help Rosa. The massive despair of a special existence like Jin was the most essential element for Rosa right now.
Therefore, Joshua suddenly trembled, feeling as if he was suffocating. He was breathless with the fear of failure and thus disappointing his mother again.
Of course, Jin saw right through his inner turmoil. However, there was no pleasure in this, it felt like beating an insect.
"Speaking of which, you also tried to assassinate Dante with Aylan Vermont. You failed then because I found out in advance, and it's the same now. Looking back, you've never beaten me."
"[But I, and Aylan Vermont, are still alive.]"
Jin was reading the flow of soul force that opens the dimensional gate. He intended to track that flow to find the space where Joshua was hiding.
"Are you proud of that? You're hiding quite far away. It seems outside the forest. If you want to stop this disgusting charade, just wait there. I'll come find you after cleaning up here."
Of course, Jin didn't expect Joshua to quietly wait until he arrived.
In any case, it would take quite some time to deal with the remaining six fake and one real Yona, and the Nethan monsters.

It's not as simple as just annihilating everyone except for the real Yona. They had to be dealt with perfectly to ensure that they didn't escape outside and cause casualties in the perimeter or civilian houses.
So, Jin intended to send someone else to Joshua.
With a crack, the top of the veil split in half and a golden aura rushed in. Bale had torn the veil from the outside.
"[Oh! I was getting annoyed, this is good. Hey, Jin. Can I just sweep them all up? Except your sisters.]"
"You have a separate task, Bale."
"[Can't you just let me kill them? It would relieve some stress.]"
"No. Instead, I'll tell you who to kill. Go outside the forest and find Joshua."
"[Who's that.]"

"The one who formed this veil. He's probably around the twelve o'clock direction outside the forest. He'll have regeneration, resurrection abilities, tear him to death several times. That's not bad, right?"
When Bale was about to hesitate, Hedo opened his mouth.
"Why hesitate, Bale. Go right now. Before the bastard escapes."
"[Tsk... Fine, got it.]"
As Bale left, Jin fired a flare to signal the gathering.
